The STF has 11 justices. What did Zanin do before becoming an STF justice? Oh yes, he was Lula’s criminal defense lawyer in his corruption cases. 

If this blatant rigging of the elections will be used to announce that Lula won, is Lula seriously expecting anyone in the international community to recognize that as a free and fair election? He knows nobody will.

卧槽！我开发的 Markdown 和 HTML 预览 iOS 应用「即览」终于上架了！目前国区限免！

苹果上架时真的麻烦啊，审核等了十一天。

主要帮大家解决 AI 时代两大主流文件在手机上无法预览的问题。

手机上的各个应用对这两类文件的预览其实都不太好：Markdown 就别说了，最近有些虽然支持了但体验并不好；

HTML 文件的话，即使是浏览器本身，想要打开本地的 HTML 文件也非常麻烦。

你只需要在文件的打开方式中选择「即览」，就能快速打开。而且我做了很多优化，比如字号调整、夜间模式、比例调节等等，欢迎大家尝试！

OpenAI's computer-using agents can now operate almost any app the way a person does, clicking and typing through software that never got an API, and the team building them says they're close to beating expert humans on speed.

Ari Weinstein works on OpenAI's consumer computer use products, and James Sun works on the enterprise side. Both were startup founders before joining OpenAI.

They join a16z's Seema Amble and Fabrizio Serafini to discuss what OpenAI's Astra model changed for computer use, the controls enterprises need for agents they can no longer watch, why computer use works as a universal API for legacy ERPs and finance systems, and why they think cheap software will push UI to get better and more personal.
